builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Empowered Savagery attack within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Empowered Savagery attack within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Empowered Savagery attack tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Rune reasoning: Rengar — Empowered Savagery attack: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: Empowered Q is source level-breakpoint base+1.2AD. Bonetooth increases bonusAD; high AD/crit tests attack while physical penetration applies. IE supplies75AD,25% crit and30% crit damage. Collector/Essence Reaver/Lord Dominik reach100% item crit with IE. Bloodt Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Nimbus Cloak: Summoner-triggered movement utility; not a free damage or stat buff. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Haste: Cooldown utility; no extra casts inside a one-cast benchmark. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.
Rune preparation: Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Helper crit interaction unresolved; separate ordinary crit, Q bonus, R leap and Spellblade; no blanket IE multiplier. Raw statFormula=2/Stat identifiers remain source evidence until runtime mapping confirmed; no unspecified stats/stacks granted.
tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.name: Battle Roar: ordinary plus empowered AP burst
builds.summary: Investigate high ordinary and empowered Battle Roar sequence output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high ordinary and empowered Battle Roar sequence output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Ordinary rank-5 W is 170 + 0.8 AP magic. Empowered W has its own level-table base plus 0.8 AP, so a legally prepared ordinary/empowered pair has 1.6 AP scaling before mitigation. Healing from recent damage and the empowered cleanse are separate outputs. There is no ordinary attack or critical bonus on the roars.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. No free permanent stacks. Record actual AD/AP and resists; stop observed scoring when a target dies and report raw overkill separately. Begin with exactly three Ferocity and ordinary W available; its legal cast earns the fourth, then empowered W is used. Verify the current client permits this sequence. One champion in both roars, no takedown resets, Q/E/R damage or extra attack. Riftmaker already ramped. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 1s. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Prior champion combat 4s does not automatically grant arbitrary item stacks.

Cut Down: Eligible non-true damage only while victim is above 60% HP; re-evaluate each packet.
